reason: Customers paying into escrow and getting a written warranty automatically is the part that makes me willing to try it, since I already get most of my bookings from WhatsApp and Instagram and do not want to chase payments. I would test it on one or two jobs before committing more.
objection: When and how exactly do I get paid, and what happens if a customer disputes the job after the money is held?
would_change_my_mind: A clear written answer on payout timing and a dispute process that protects me as the installer, shown before I upload my ID and commercial registration.
